interpretation: All sixteen complete XML trees and raw XML byte pairs match. Eleven full frames differ; the five final complete PNG pairs are identical. All differences are retained in the reported full-frame counts.

Both original and candidate record the same IllegalStateException type and ten-frame stack. Their literal messages differ in runtime fragment instance IDs; full raw logs and messages remain unchanged.

Both main processes die and both later capture NewHomeScreenActivity. The original replacement process first starts for crashguard SystemJobService; the candidate replacement first starts for the home activity. These literal hosting events differ, so full lifecycle equality is not established. This is post-crash continuation, not a benign or crash-free restart claim.

Both close the observed LITEAPKS dialog, reach home and the empty editor, acknowledge Favourite Triggers information with the observed button1, then capture the trigger/action/constraint catalogs and return with BACK. All thirty recorded inputs are verified against their raw preinput hierarchy and process evidence.

The preserved sixteen-step comparator remains REJECTED for initial-PID continuity even though both recordings complete. This analysis does not relax that comparator or claim a passing journey. The earlier dimming/dot failures remain unchanged historical evidence.

The artifact records one successful acquisition per named screen, not consecutive identical full-frame observations. Settling of the differing status icon, page dots, or notification background is not established by this run. Diagnostic row counts identify positions only; no row is removed from equality.
